caption: A ball rolls past a wall of glass bricks, and seen through the bricks it appears as a broken row of warped pieces that move together.

sa.check: A ball rolls past a wall of glass bricks.
Seen through the bricks it appears as a broken row of pieces.

pc.expect: The ball is whole and normal where it passes the open edge; the broken pieces are appearances through the bricks.
pc.fail: The ball is broken past the edge; or it is whole and sharp through the bricks; or it changes shape.

pc.expect: The distorted pieces move in step with the ball and only within the bricks.
pc.fail: The pieces lag; or appear outside the bricks; or remain after the ball has passed.

pc.expect: The ball rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or restarts.
They ripple; or bend; or go opaque.
A second ball appears; or the wall vanishes; or the ball passes through a brick.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the wall changes; or the floor changes.
